title: Regularity of strict henselization divisor quotient
statement: Let R be a commutative regular ring and f in R such that R/(f) is regular. Let Ω be an algebraically closed field and barY : Spec Ω → Spec R a geometric point. Let b : R → strictHenselizationRing barY induce the canonical strict henselization structural morphism on spectra. If b(f) is not a unit, then strictHenselizationRing barY/(b(f)) is regular.

proof.text: Apply the upstream Noetherianity and prime-local regularity theorem to the full affine-neighbourhood strict henselization and the supplied structural ring map. Its regular-local conclusion at every prime is exactly the field defining IsRegularRing. The equivalent small-colimit formulation is recovered explicitly in both live consumers using the canonical colimit comparison, its structural-map equation, and Ideal.quotientEquiv followed by IsRegularRing.of_ringEquiv.
